name: SliceIndex
documentation:
A helper trait used for indexing operations.

 Implementations of this trait have to promise that if the argument
 to `get_unchecked(_mut)` is a safe reference, then so is the result.
rules: Implementors of SliceIndex must guarantee that if the argument to get_unchecked is a safe reference, its result is also a safe reference.
Implementors of SliceIndex must guarantee that if the argument to get_unchecked_mut is a safe reference, its result is also a safe reference.
